name: ⚔️ Lanebreakers: Hero Arena 5v5
description:
A real 5v5 hero battle arena for phones and PC! Pick a role and a hero, push your lane with your minions, destroy the enemy towers and break their Nexus.

⚔️ 11 heroes with 4 unique abilities each: tanks, mages, marksmen, assassins, fighters and supports
🤖 Play solo right away - bots fill every empty slot
🗺️ 3 lanes, a river and a jungle with drakes, the Herald and the Abyss Tyrant
🛒 Buy items with gold every match, or let Auto-Buy do it for you
💎 Earn crystals every match to unlock new heroes and skins
📜 Daily quests, hero mastery, achievements with titles and a wins leaderboard
🎁 Daily rewards, win streaks, MVP bonus and a first-win bonus every day
⏱️ Matches take about 15-25 minutes

Controls: move with the stick or right-click. Your hero attacks automatically. Tap an enemy to focus it. Q / W / E / R for abilities, D / F for spells, B to recall, P for the shop. Ping your team with 📍!
